help.schema:
Usage: portfolio schema [OPTIONS] COMMAND

  Print the response JSON schema for a portfolio subcommand.

  Reads ``/openapi.json`` from the portfolio-ai backend and projects the
  response schema for the path that backs ``<command>``. This lets agents
  introspect contracts without a trial call.

Arguments:
  COMMAND  Subcommand to introspect (e.g. tlh-candidates)  [required]

Options:
  --remote  Use production hosts.production_api endpoint
  --help    Show this message and exit.
help.drift:
Usage: portfolio drift [OPTIONS]

  Show how far each asset class is from its goal allocation.

  Default response is a single-line digest. Pass ``--no-summary`` for the full
  per-class table.

Options:
  --scope TEXT              household | account  [default: household]
  --scope-id TEXT           Scope identifier  [default: default]
  --summary / --no-summary  Compact digest (default) vs full row table
                            [default: summary]
  --human                   Plain-English rendering
  --remote                  Use production hosts.production_api endpoint
  --help                    Show this message and exit.
help.rebalance:
Usage: portfolio rebalance [OPTIONS]

  Propose tax-aware trades to close the drift gap.

  Three-pass: route buys to tax-advantaged first, prefer long-term
  losses/gains over short-term on sells, run wash-sale check on every taxable
  sell and reroute or flag conflicts.

Options:
  --scope TEXT                    household | account  [default: household]
  --scope-id TEXT                 Scope identifier  [default: default]
  --prefer-tax-advantaged / --no-prefer-tax-advantaged
                                  Route buys to Roth/IRA/401k first  [default:
                                  prefer-tax-advantaged]
  --prefer-ltcg / --no-prefer-ltcg
                                  Prefer long-term over short-term gains on
                                  sells  [default: prefer-ltcg]
  --human                         Plain-English rendering
  --remote                        Use production hosts.production_api endpoint
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
help.catalysts:
Usage: portfolio catalysts [OPTIONS]

  List upcoming catalysts (earnings, ex-dividend, FOMC) sorted by date.

  Compact JSON projection by default — ``{symbol, kind, date, days_until}``
  per row. Pass ``--detail`` for ``time_of_day``, ``confirmed``, and
  ``source`` fields. ``--kinds`` narrows the merge to a subset.

Options:
  --days INTEGER RANGE            Lookahead window in days  [default: 14;
                                  1<=x<=365]
  --limit INTEGER RANGE           Maximum events to return  [default: 20;
                                  1<=x<=200]
  --kinds TEXT                    Comma-separated subset of
                                  earnings,ex_dividend,fomc
  --include-watchlist / --no-include-watchlist
                                  Include watchlist symbols (in addition to
                                  portfolio holdings)  [default: include-
                                  watchlist]
  --symbols TEXT                  Comma-separated symbols (overrides default
                                  universe)
  --detail                        Add time_of_day, confirmed, source to each
                                  row
  --human                         Plain-English rendering
  --remote                        Use production hosts.production_api endpoint
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
help.tlh:
Usage: portfolio tlh [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Tax-loss harvesting + wash-sale detection

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  candidates       List taxable positions trading below cost...
  wash-sale-check  Check the household's 61-day window for...
help.tlh candidates:
Usage: portfolio tlh candidates [OPTIONS]

  List taxable positions trading below cost (most-actionable first).

  Compact JSON by default. ``--detail`` adds replacement, holding period,
  ST/LT loss split, and wash-sale annotations.

Options:
  --limit INTEGER RANGE       Maximum candidates to return  [default: 20;
                              1<=x<=100]
  --min-loss FLOAT RANGE      Minimum dollar loss  [default: 500.0; x>=0.0]
  --min-loss-pct FLOAT RANGE  Minimum loss as fraction of cost basis
                              [default: 0.05; 0.0<=x<=1.0]
  --detail                    Include replacement, holding period, ST/LT
                              split, wash-sale annotations
  --summary                   Single-line digest only
  --human                     Plain-English rendering
  --remote                    Use the production hosts.production_api endpoint
  --help                      Show this message and exit.
help.tlh wash-sale-check:
Usage: portfolio tlh wash-sale-check [OPTIONS]

  Check the household's 61-day window for substantially-identical buys.

  Per IRS Pub 550 and Rev. Rul. 2008-5, the scan covers spouse accounts and
  tax-advantaged accounts (Roth, IRA, 401k, HSA).

Options:
  --symbol TEXT        Ticker to check (e.g. AAPL)  [required]
  --sell-date TEXT     Proposed sell date (YYYY-MM-DD)  [required]
  --household-id TEXT  Household scope for cross-account check  [required]
  --human              Plain-English rendering
  --remote             Use production hosts.production_api endpoint
  --help               Show this message and exit.

help.retirement-plan:
Usage: portfolio retirement-plan [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Stress-test your retirement plan against thousands of futures

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  run   Run + persist one retirement Monte Carlo scenario.
  list  List recent retirement scenarios for one household.
  show  Show one retirement scenario by id.
help.retirement-plan run:
Usage: portfolio retirement-plan run [OPTIONS]

  Run + persist one retirement Monte Carlo scenario.

  Stress tests the household plan across ``--trials`` simulated futures
  (default 10,000; capped at 50,000). Pass ``--seed N`` for a reproducible
  run.

Options:
  --household-id TEXT             Household scope identifier  [required]
  --trials INTEGER RANGE          Number of simulated futures  [default:
                                  10000; 1<=x<=50000]
  --name TEXT                     Scenario label (auto-generated if omitted)
  --seed INTEGER                  Deterministic random seed
  --annual-expenses FLOAT RANGE   Override annual spend in dollars  [x>=0.0]
  --retirement-age INTEGER RANGE  Override target retirement age  [18<=x<=120]
  --horizon-years INTEGER RANGE   Override projection horizon  [1<=x<=70]
  --human                         Plain-English rendering
  --remote                        Use production hosts.production_api endpoint
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
